title: smime-tree CertChainError: deprecated variants not noted in enum-level doc
description: smime-tree/src/error.rs:64-84 — AllTrustAnchorsExpired and PathLenViolated are marked #[deprecated] with notes saying they are never emitted, but the enum-level doc comment does not mention this. A user reading just the enum docs would not know some variants are dead. The Display impl uses allow(deprecated) to suppress the lint, which further hides this. Fix: add a note to the CertChainError enum doc explaining which variants are compatibility-only stubs that are never produced by this crate.
